newsitem.title: USA: Grand Union sells shares to chairman.
newsitem.headline: Grand Union sells shares to chairman.

text.p: Grand Union Co said on Tuesday it sold $20 million worth of 8.5 percent Class A convertible preferred stock to an investment group that has agreed to buy a total of $100 million of these shares.
The company also agreed in principle to sell another 60,000 preferred shares to its chairman, Roger Stangeland, for $3 million.

The conversion price of the preferred shares is $7.25 per share. The investment group, which includes affiliates of Shamrock Capital Advisors Inc, has agreed to purchase a total of $100 million of these shares in stages by February 1998. Including the sale concluded Tuesday, the group now has $60 million worth of these shares.
Grand Union operates 226 retail food stores in six Northeastern states.
